item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_pattern: Write and edit autocrafting patterns remotely.
item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_craftin: Access and craft on the network remotely. Right-click air to open once bound.
Right-click a Wireless Transmitter to bind, right-click air to open. Sneak + right-click to install upgrades.
item.rswirelesscrafting.upgrade.install_: Install into a terminal: sneak + right-click the terminal.
item.rswirelesscrafting.range_upgrade.de: No distance limit in the same dimension.
item.rswirelesscrafting.interdimensional: Requires a bound Network Receiver and both chunks loaded.
item.rswirelesscrafting.remote_energy_up: Uses network energy instead of the terminal battery.
Requires a bound network with stored energy.
item.rswirelesscrafting.advanced_energy_: Distance energy becomes 100%% in the same dimension.
block.rswirelesscrafting.charging_statio: Charges terminals. 3 wired slots, wireless for nearby players, refilled from the network.
Wired: 3 slots at %s FE/s each, lossless.
Wireless serves 3 devices at a time.
Idle drain %s FE/s, charging billed separately.
Redstone stops wireless charging and pauses the idle drain.
Station buffer, refilled from the network when low.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.title: Refined Network Configuration
rswirelesscrafting.configuration.title: Refined Network Configuration
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Configuration for the Wireless Crafting Grid.
The energy capacity of the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Extra energy capacity granted by a single Battery Upgrade.
The energy usage of opening the Wireless Crafting Grid.
The energy usage of crafting an item in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
The energy usage of autocrafting a resource with the Wireless Crafting Grid.
The energy usage of clearing the crafting matrix in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
The energy usage of transferring a recipe in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Distance-based energy pricing for wireless devices.
Within this distance usage is unchanged (x1); beyond it the multiplier grows linearly (multiplier = distance / base range).
Energy multiplier (percent) applied when the device is used across dimensions.
The Energy Upgrade divides the distance multiplier by this value.
Configuration for the Terminal Charging Station.
Base idle energy drain of the station in FE/s (charging is billed separately). A redstone signal pauses it, so a higher value makes the redstone switch worthwhile.
Master switch for the idle drain: when disabled, the station never drains while idle (wireless charging still works).
Energy per second transferred to each item in the wired slots.
Energy per second transferred to each device in nearby players' inventories.
Wireless charging efficiency (percent): only this share of the drawn energy reaches the device, the rest is lost. Wired charging is always 100%.
Radius (in blocks) of the wireless charging area.
Capacity of the station's internal buffer, refilled from the network when not full.

item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_autocra: View and move patterns across all autocrafters remotely.

gui.rswirelesscrafting.terminal_not_enou: Not enough energy. Charge the terminal first.
block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_bridge: Extends the network to a distant place, across dimensions. Keeps both chunks loaded.
Unpaired: anchor. Sits on the network, waiting for another bridge.
Paired: endpoint. The network is here; RS cables work next to it.
Both chunks stay force-loaded after pairing; expensive.
Pair: right-click the base point with the wireless connector to record it, then right-click the far bridge; right-click the endpoint again to unbind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.anchor_hin: not paired. sneak + right-click to make it the base point
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.offline: not connected: check the anchor and chunk loading.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.anchor_set: Base point recorded. Right-click the far wireless bridge with the wireless connector to pair.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.bound: Paired. Now working as the far endpoint.
block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_bridge: Redstone suspends hauling and drain; chunks stay kept.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.suspended: suspended by redstone; chunks still kept.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Extends your network to a distant place, across dimensions.
When off, paired bridges stop hauling (chunks stay kept until unbound).
A pair counts as two bridges.
Extra drain per held chunk (deliberately expensive by default); a pair usually holds two. Set 0 for free chunk keeping.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.unpaid: unpaid and stopped; chunks still kept, reconnects when powered.
item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_configu: Copies settings from RS blocks; paste singly or in bulk.
Right-click a block to copy its settings.
Right-click a block to paste. Sneak + right-click to apply to nearby blocks of the same type.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.config_card.hint: Right-click an RS block: copies if empty, pastes if loaded (sneak = bulk)
msg.rswirelesscrafting.config_card.wrong: The card holds settings for another block type
item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_monitor: Watches up to 4 items and alerts or restocks when out of range.
No targets set. Right-click to open and place items in the left slots.

Halves the wait per card, up to 4.
Only affects RS autocrafters; +32 FE/t per card.

Right-click a network block to record an access point, right-click a device to bind; right-click a bound device again to unbind; sneak + right-click to clear.

Sneak-right-click one end to mark it as the input, then sneak-right-click another to pair. Sneak-right-click again to unpair.
